from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LegalCase(BaseModel):
    """A single legal case document extracted from a document."""
    document_title: str | None = Field(description="The unique title or identifier of the document (e.g., '《判决文书 1》')")
    cause_category: str | None = Field(description="The specific legal cause category of the case as described in the document")
    case_type: str | None = Field(description="Broad classification of the case type (e.g., '民事', '行政', '刑事')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    cases: list[LegalCase]
